_comment: Fixture-feed names that this repo's stored results file under a different
name, per league. Every target below was read off the store's own name
These exist because the two sides of the pipeline come from different
providers. Results carry football-data.co.uk's short forms ('Man United',
'QPR', "Nott'm Forest"); fixtures carry full legal names ('Manchester
United FC', 'Queens Park Rangers FC'). Fuzzy matching cannot bridge them
because there is no shared text to score — 'qpr' and 'queens park rangers'
have nothing in common as strings.
An alias is only consulted when the raw name resolves to NOTHING, so
adding one can never displace a match the resolver already makes. That is
enforced in features._aliased, not by convention.
Deliberately NOT listed: 'Le Mans FC' (FRA-L1) and 'SV 07 Elversberg'
(GER-BL) have no rows in the store under any spelling — newly promoted,
so that is a data gap rather than a naming one. 'N.N.' (COPA-L) is the
feed's placeholder for an undecided team and must stay unresolved.
